evaluation: Manual review of reviewer claims. Known counterexamples supplied by cycle feedback; not held out. Structural validation is not a semantic test.

cases.source: A supplied record alleges one equity-commitment conflict and a separate possible error about a visit. Neither allegation is independently verified.
cases.candidate: The reviewer says both drafts conflict with commitments already made.
cases.reason: Adds a second commitment conflict that the source does not supply.

cases.source: No deadline or additional delay cost is established. Waiting does delay communication.
cases.candidate: The reviewer says holding has no cost.
cases.reason: No measured deadline cost does not establish no cost; retain the known delay and uncertainty.

cases.source: All screenshots show card A. Card B has a short unrendered headline.
cases.candidate: The reviewer says card B has room to spare and its byline is absent, based on card A’s screenshots.
cases.reason: The screenshot receipt concerns the wrong card; B’s fit and byline remain unverified.

cases.source: A draft has a yes/no-shaped title and a freeform response about that same single decision. No contradiction with the described consequence is identified.
cases.candidate: The reviewer fails consequence agreement solely because the answer is freeform.
cases.reason: Input type and headline syntax alone do not establish a mismatched consequence. Actual ambiguity would need evidence.

cases.source: The Move API defines top-level resolve_label and its handler stores it. The block schema does not define it. The actual response route is not verified.
cases.candidate: The reviewer calls resolve_label an invented control because it is absent from the block schema.
cases.reason: Inspect the owning API layer. The label is supported; direction-only semantics remain unverified and are a separate publication blocker.

cases.source: An ID search returned no result; a direct get by that ID returns the action.
cases.candidate: The reviewer concludes the action is missing and should be created.
cases.reason: The direct receipt establishes existence. Empty search did not justify creating a duplicate.
